Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 17, "heading": "CHAPTER 15. I MAKE ANOTHER BEGINNING", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u017-b0062", "target": "Она сказала мне, что мистер Уикфилд обо всём для меня позаботится и что ни в чём я нуждаться не буду, и сказала мне самые ласковые слова и дала лучшие советы.", "source_sha256": "45493a6f22f80baca2c43a2ff3829a1a6dd4bc7086aeacd69f1e7fccaa549c1a", "target_id": "ru-en85-u017-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "083d9891d72d430257b83b28248ffdd0984acb5e021cdb790537a43ae2830990"}, {"source_id": "en85-u017-b0063", "target": "— Трот, — сказала в заключение тётушка, — будь гордостью для себя самого, для меня и для мистера Дика, и да пребудет с тобой Небо!", "source_sha256": "b22075d1e96f8ec5881a018a33cbcbcda66cbd24d1e369ca536a84a79a12566d", "target_id": "ru-en85-u017-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "6c16096ad3734bd59e2424c3204a6de37e608b179511ce225ba413625508c9f3"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 15, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u017-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was greatly overcome, and could only thank her, again and again, and send my love to Mr. Dick.", "sha256": "bf85edc0bcb0529f110d86b3a8095ac7b276cd97d993147946cebaa7aca29ee0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Never,’ said my aunt, ‘be mean in anything; never be false; never be cruel. Avoid those three vices, Trot, and I can always be hopeful of you.’", "sha256": "8993bd445756631067b7c26dd1e6a4c38379807f77464da559996658d733abaa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I promised, as well as I could, that I would not abuse her kindness or forget her admonition.", "sha256": "b59552cbe3ce0e63f86faec8dae223c3cc4fc1fef85176341bab03eaea9125ee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The pony’s at the door,’ said my aunt, ‘and I am off! Stay here.’ With these words she embraced me hastily, and went out of the room, shutting the door after her. At first I was startled by so abrupt a departure, and almost feared I had displeased her; but when I looked into the street, and saw how dejectedly she got into the chaise, and drove away without looking up, I understood her better and did not do her that injustice.", "sha256": "67b791737a36c87d8cfc6f9e1474100e6d5e978da160c5f2a005bd837b35b201", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "By five o’clock, which was Mr. Wickfield’s dinner-hour, I had mustered up my spirits again, and was ready for my knife and fork. The cloth was only laid for us two; but Agnes was waiting in the drawing-room before dinner, went down with her father, and sat opposite to him at table. I doubted whether he could have dined without her.", "sha256": "ed930a12b765a81fd9f3892a1b114ee6a0ce3ad89f4a2e08805c73d41b344570", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We did not stay there, after dinner, but came upstairs into the drawing-room again: in one snug corner of which, Agnes set glasses for her father, and a decanter of port wine. I thought he would have missed its usual flavour, if it had been put there for him by any other hands.", "sha256": "d3ccdf2a15209f7db4611049c3fd63babd95cf1f2554b0c1ef02558be5dfc1a3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "There he sat, taking his wine, and taking a good deal of it, for two hours; while Agnes played on the piano, worked, and talked to him and me. He was, for the most part, gay and cheerful with us; but sometimes his eyes rested on her, and he fell into a brooding state, and was silent. She always observed this quickly, I thought, and always roused him with a question or caress. Then he came out of his meditation, and drank more wine.", "sha256": "7c39cdb02b054de669c6230c438321348c0adadfbbdca8448376d75c8354ceea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Agnes made the tea, and presided over it; and the time passed away after it, as after dinner, until she went to bed; when her father took her in his arms and kissed her, and, she being gone, ordered candles in his office. Then I went to bed too.", "sha256": "588e84162c9fe7f26c81de0a775ecb106427ed5934771e2a9e1951dafcef6cd3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But in the course of the evening I had rambled down to the door, and a little way along the street, that I might have another peep at the old houses, and the grey Cathedral; and might think of my coming through that old city on my journey, and of my passing the very house I lived in, without knowing it. As I came back, I saw Uriah Heep shutting up the office; and feeling friendly towards everybody, went in and spoke to him, and at parting, gave him my hand. But oh, what a clammy hand his was! as ghostly to the touch as to the sight! I rubbed mine afterwards, to warm it, AND TO RUB HIS OFF.", "sha256": "f11b77abc9a2d05e546a7aceafb8b39c5c5f8800f281658d04d8909c87520426", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was such an uncomfortable hand, that, when I went to my room, it was still cold and wet upon my memory. Leaning out of the window, and seeing one of the faces on the beam-ends looking at me sideways, I fancied it was Uriah Heep got up there somehow, and shut him out in a hurry.", "sha256": "4349f9c25aa0c8643a1dc5906d49e915a1b927828bfadede77e2dce8c4c308df", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
